verdict.rationale: Docs show broad API coverage of core subscription, invoicing, entitlements, and data import/export features (recurly-docs-1,8,10,11) alongside official client libraries (recurly-docs-13), suggesting most UI actions are API-accessible. However, there is no explicit statement of full UI/API parity, and some UI-only features like dunning campaign configuration (recurly-docs-5) aren't confirmed as API-manageable. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee or comprehensive API reference mapping every UI action, and independent confirmation that all UI-configurable settings (e.g., dunning campaigns) are exposed via API.
